title: Univé shows how governance and employee builders can scale workplace AI
friendlyTitle: An insurer lets employees build useful AI tools safely
summary: Dutch insurer Univé says 85% of its activated ChatGPT Enterprise users are active weekly and employees have created about 1,500 custom GPTs. Its rollout combines leadership training, inherited data permissions and human accountability; one claims workflow now prepares files in minutes rather than hours.
friendlySummary: Univé trained staff, set clear data rules and let employees create about 1,500 custom AI helpers. One pet-insurance process now prepares claims in minutes instead of hours.
whyItMatters: The case study offers a practical adoption pattern: establish permissions and accountability first, then give domain experts time to redesign their own work. The figures come from a vendor customer story, but the operating model is more transferable than a simple licence rollout.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Companies can learn from the order of work: set safety rules first, then help the people who know each job build better processes. Humans still make the final decisions.
